name: recurrent-unit-sizing-2026-10-21
hypothesis: Masked recurrent requests long exposure below full capacity and costs alone do not close holding gaps. Test fixed unit-magnitude signed exposure while retaining every learned protective component and recomputing account/memory state. This may amplify losing trades; no assumption of improved returns.
transform: For every symbol/session, exposure becomes sign(raw exposure): -1,0,+1. Other three raw outputs remain bitwise unchanged. All actions remain risk-approved under existing simulator; target exposure is not guaranteed executed exposure.

screen_gate.failure: Stop this fixed sizing diagnostic with no threshold/magnitude sweep or promotion after any gate failure

constraints.selection: No checkpoint/threshold selection or promotion. Report both fixed phases on every original26 symbol. Future declining labels reporting only.
constraints.causality: Fresh simulator per episode/mode, recompute causal account and masked execution state and carry/reset recurrent memory on that path.
constraints.execution: Same costs,whole shares,100k equity,exposure cap1,next-session fills,learned protections,corporate actions and20-session holding limit. Never disable stops/targets or borrowing.
constraints.gate: Verify BOTH unrestricted phases against source paths before candidate replay. On any parity failure record differences, stop, do not relax tolerance or interpret candidate results.
constraints.integrity: Require clean committed source/protocol, complete owned-session cleanup, accepted model/report hashes, frozen selected bundle, immutable weights/normalization and unchanged updates.
constraints.limits: Repeated development and survivor history; no independent or prospective evidence. A passing diagnostic alone never achieves the objective.
constraints.failure: No magnitude/threshold grid, sign inversion, extra phases, candidate checkpoint selection or new training after failure.
